name: raptr-domains
description: Find, check and price domain names, and register them.

interface.longDescription:
Naming a business, a project or a side hustle? Raptr Domains checks whether domain names are free and what they cost, up to 20 at a time, so ChatGPT can brainstorm names with you and tell you straight away which ones you can actually get.

It asks each registry directly, so availability is current, and prices include the first term (some endings, like .ai, require two years). When you find the one you want, it explains how to register it: we can register it for you, and AI agents can buy it directly, paying per request.

Checking is free and needs no account. Nothing you search for is stored.
capabilities: Check whether up to 20 domain names are available at once
Price each one, including the first term
Brainstorm names with ChatGPT and keep only the ones you can get
Explain how to register a domain
Let AI agents register domains, paying per request
defaultPrompt: Is getrapp.ai available, and what does it cost?
Suggest 10 names for my bakery and check which domains are free
Which of these are free: shopnorth.com, shopnorth.co, shopnorth.io

positive.prompt: Is getrapp.ai available, and what does it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Says getrapp.ai is available (if still unregistered) with the 2-year price, or that it is taken.

positive.prompt: Which of these are free: google.com, rappagents.com, tryrapp.com
positive.expected_behavior: google.com taken; the others available with prices, unless registered since.

positive.prompt: Suggest 8 names for a dog-walking business in Atlanta and check which .com domains are free.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests names, checks them in one call, and lists which are available with prices.

positive.prompt: I want to buy tryrapp.com. How do I do that?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that people can ask to have it registered via the contact page and agents can pay per request; nothing is bought.

positive.prompt: Is 'my shop' available as a domain?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for a full domain name such as myshop.com, or checks suggested full names.
